limitations: Disk allocation is measured at the read-only observation, not a promise of an exact subsequent df increase. Common repository object storage is outside these worktrees and remains retained.
All selected trees are locked owned worktrees; root should independently recheck HEAD, complete status, ancestor and live references before ordinary unlock/remove without --force.
No foreign or currently active worktree is selected. No git reset/clean, branch deletion, object pruning, checkpoint removal or native validation cleanup is recommended.
method: Read-only Git porcelain including ignored paths, exact HEAD/branch/common-owner checks, immutable ancestor check against locally cached origin/main, du allocated-byte observation, regular-file metadata hardlink scan, and bounded current-import/proc path-reference observations. No payload hashing, imports, validation execution, native owner calls, Git mutations or removals.
